text_block_list.text:
The last big race of Nature's senior year,
the
Arima Kinen, is finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's an extremely important race for Nice
Nature.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hold on! Before that...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ahem... Can I say something?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna say something embarrassing.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Thank you for leading me to this point.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I used to think my goal was unreachable,
even
though I never even tried to run
toward it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But not now. Now I understand that it's
up to me
to make my dream come true.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
"Close, but not quite." That's me in a
nutshell.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I run okay, but "okay" isn't gonna win me the gold.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm joining that race to show everyone
what I can
do... Ugh, why did Teio have
to join?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The once self-doubting Найс Нэйчер
from back
when I first met her is gone.
As she is now, I'm
sure she can win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Get out there and shine, Nature!

text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm... I'm gonna shine like never
before!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And I'll bring the shiniest trophy back to
you!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen is filled with
great
runners. Among them, one has her
gaze fixed on
Найс Нэйчер, eyes
gleaming.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you, Nature.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think? You can still
take back
what you said last time!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Really? In that case, I'll take you up on
that...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Well, that's what I would've said before.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not taking it back. I'll say it again
and
again.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I'm going to win!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's the spirit!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
It's on! In case you've forgotten, I'm
prepared to
remind you as many times as
necessary...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: I am the Invincible Teio!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I know. More than you could ever
guess.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But you know, I have what it takes to be
amazing
as well.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me knows it. My trainer
knows
it... and I know it too!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: So I'm not losing!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be the star of this year's
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
